dedupe_keys.name: dodge construction network project intelligence and construction starts data

description: Dodge Construction Network sells commercial construction project intelligence and market data, tracking more than 700,000 projects a year and publishing more than 7,000 project updates each day. Subscribers find planning-stage projects before bidding with specifications, documents and the architects, owners and contractors involved; market products give quarterly and annual forecasts by building type, material category and territory down to county level, benchmarks against decades of verified construction starts, and market share views, and research draws on more than 100 years of verified starts and more than 10 million historical projects. Data can be plugged into customers' own systems. Coverage: commercial construction projects and starts tracked by Dodge, with forecasts down to county level. Access: subscription after a demo. Licence: commercial; paid. Caveats: data are proprietary and project records depend on Dodge's reporting coverage. Simulation uses are pipelines of planned buildings and construction starts for future stock, demand and investment scenarios. Related records: the U.S. Census Building Permits Survey and Glenigan for the UK.
